description: This file defines the DeleteMultipleObjectsException class, which is a custom exception extending PHP's base Exception class. It is used within the AWS SDK for PHP to handle errors that occur when attempting to delete multiple objects in an S3 bucket. The class includes methods for constructing the exception with details about successfully deleted objects and errors, as well as static methods for creating error messages from error arrays.

classes.name: DeleteMultipleObjectsException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors during bulk deletion of objects in S3 using AWS SDK for PHP. It carries details of successfully deleted objects and errors encountered.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with arrays of deleted objects and errors, setting a detailed message.

methods.name: createMessageFromErrors
methods.description: Generates a combined error message string from an array of error details.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of error details encountered during deletion.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Returns an array of successfully deleted objects.
